_comment_for_humans: Eagle3 draft config for mistralai/Mistral-Medium-3.5-128B. Target is dense 128B Mistral3 (text_config.model_type=ministral3): 88 layers, hidden 12288, GQA 96:8, vocab 131072, max_pos 262144 (YaRN factor 64). Draft is the standard Eagle3 1-layer Llama trunk with hidden_size matched to the target. eagle_aux_hidden_state_layer_ids=[1,42,84] is the V3.2-fractional spacing scaled to 88 layers; alternates [2,44,85] (sglang default) and [1,29,57] (V3.2 verbatim) reserved for exp-b axis. draft_vocab_size 32000 is the standard reduction; if SpecForge balks at the 131072→32000 mapping, fallback is draft_vocab_size 131072. See experiments/Mistral-Medium-3.5/architecture-notes.md.
